summary: xAI released a free Grok add-in for Microsoft PowerPoint that lets users generate and edit slide decks using Grok, including research, styling, and connector-based content pulled from email, SharePoint or Google Drive.

practices.reason: Teams building on Grok would note a new distribution surface (Microsoft Marketplace add-in) but it creates no meaningful integration work for backend engineering teams.
practices.quote: Grok for PowerPoint is a free Microsoft 365 add-in. Add it from the Microsoft Marketplace , and work directly with Grok in your presentations.

practices.reason: The add-in describes a connector-based tool-use pattern (pulling from email, SharePoint, Google Drive) but gives no implementation detail or measured gain to build from.
practices.quote: The add-in is also able to leverage your Grok connectors - ask it to write slides based on recent emails, or files in your SharePoint or Google Drive.
